description: Ministry of City Planning & Water Supply - Eratta made to suggest to rectify the name of G.N. Division of the order published in Gaz. Ex. No. 1743/10 of 31.01.2012
reasoning: This gazette content involves a correction to a legal notice published in a previous gazette, specifically addressing an error in the name of a Grama Niladari Division under the National Water Supply and Drainage Board Act. It constitutes a legal/regulatory matter as it deals with the amendment of a statutory instrument and does not involve government personnel changes, structural changes, or any of the other specialized categories.
